description: Authoritative build profiles for catalog artifacts. A profile describes how an artifact is produced and where its verified bytes live; it never changes an existing artifact record.

nexdrop-native-android.signing: Original NexDrop release key (certificate SHA-256 11cb2ab82ba751fea04d101bd3a1498b852581f999056a3bc371e47e326a861a); no wrapper or debug identity
nexdrop-native-android.releaseConvention: GitHub Release tag nexdrop-android-v<sha7> in PDFly-source/nexdrop, normal (non-prerelease) release carrying NexDrop-release.apk
nexdrop-native-android.verification: CI startup-smoke installs and launches the signed APK on an API 36 emulator; the release job runs only after that job succeeds; RELEASE-VERIFICATION.md records versionName/versionCode, sha256 and certificate fingerprint
